QuTiP 官方：Lindblad 主方程与适用假设: Official QuTiP documentation: the Lindblad master equation and its assumptions
David Tong：连续对称性与 Noether 定理: David Tong: continuous symmetries and Noether's theorem
由晶格类型与按指定方向排列的旋转、螺旋和镜面成分标记晶体群。: Crystallographic symbols specify the lattice type and the rotation, screw, and mirror components arranged along designated directions.
反幺正操作不能直接当作普通线性矩阵取迹来套幺正特征标正交公式。: An antiunitary operation cannot be treated as an ordinary linear matrix whose trace is inserted into unitary-character orthogonality formulas.
小群保留选定波矢模倒格矢；动量星收集它在完整群作用下的不同像。: The little group preserves a selected wavevector modulo reciprocal-lattice vectors; its momentum star collects the distinct images under the full group.
Seitz 代表元乘积多出的整格平移，在固定 k 的表示中成为相位因子。: An extra lattice translation in a product of Seitz representatives becomes a phase factor in the representation at fixed k.
反幺正对称若保留该 k 且平方为 −1，可保证 Kramers 成对。: An antiunitary symmetry guarantees Kramers pairing if it preserves the selected k and squares to −1.
无自旋时间反演常为 +1，自旋1/2 为 −1；组合磁平移还贡献 Bloch 相: The time-reversal square is commonly +1 without spin and −1 for spin 1/2; combined magnetic translations also contribute a Bloch phase.
幺正矩阵保持态的内积，可表示基变换、时间演化或对称操作的线性部分。: Unitary matrices preserve state inner products and can describe changes of basis, time evolution, or the linear part of symmetry operations.
自旋群将实空间操作与独立自旋转动配对；空间和自旋作用一般不必相同。: Spin groups pair real-space operations with independent spin rotations; their spatial and spin actions need not coincide.
不是所有独立自旋转动都保留所选磁序，也不自动适用于SOC体系。: Not every independent spin rotation preserves the chosen magnetic order, nor does it automatically apply to systems with SOC.
多轨道相互作用中，Hund 耦合控制不同轨道的自旋偏好，并和交换、自旋翻转及成对: In multiorbital interactions, Hund coupling controls spin preferences between different orbitals and is related to exchange, spin-flip, and pair-hopping terms.
旋转不变 Kanamori 参数常采用 U′=U−2J；需保留模块实际实现的项。: Rotationally invariant Kanamori parameters commonly obey U′=U−2J; retain the terms actually implemented by the module.
二阶行列式为1的幺正矩阵群；可描述自旋1/2旋量和 Bloch 球旋转。: The group of 2×2 unitary matrices with determinant 1; it describes spin-1/2 spinors and Bloch-sphere rotations.
把直积基底与耦合后不可约分量基底联系起来的单位换基矩阵元素。: Elements of a unitary change-of-basis matrix connecting the tensor-product basis to the coupled irreducible-component basis.
正负号随 Berry 联络与回路方向约定；使用同一模块的 Chern 与霍尔公式: Signs depend on the Berry-connection and loop-orientation conventions; use the Chern and Hall formulas from the same module.
闭合二维布里渊区上占据子空间 Berry 曲率的积分不变量。: An integral invariant of the occupied-subspace Berry curvature over a closed two-dimensional Brillouin zone.
沿闭合路径连乘占据子空间重叠，得到规范协变矩阵及规范不变本征相位。: Multiply occupied-subspace overlap matrices along a closed path to obtain a gauge-covariant matrix with gauge-invariant eigenphases.
二维片电导或三维电导率: Two-dimensional sheet conductance or three-dimensional conductivity
横向热电 α 与 Nernst 的区别: Transverse thermoelectric α versus the Nernst effect
α_xy描述横向热电流响应；开路Nernst电压还需要结合完整电导张量求解。: α_xy describes the transverse thermoelectric current response. Finding an open-circuit Nernst voltage additionally requires the full electrical conductivity tensor.
当前教学模块主要给内禀、非相互作用模型贡献。: The current teaching module primarily provides intrinsic contributions of noninteracting models.
谱与输运常用的推迟 resolvent，正虚部保证相应因果边界。: The retarded resolvent commonly used in spectra and transport; a positive imaginary part selects the corresponding causal boundary condition.
所选几何下两组能级间距: Energy separation between two groups of levels in the selected geometry
以局域密度排斥、Hund交换、自旋翻转及成对跃迁刻画选定多轨道子空间。: Density repulsion, Hund exchange, spin flips, and pair hopping describe a selected multiorbital subspace.
模块采用的参数关系和实际保留项应同时检查；U≥3J是某些教学输入约束。: Check both the module's parameter relations and the terms it actually retains; U≥3J is a constraint on some teaching inputs.
不是完整原子Slater积分模型；材料参数还涉及屏蔽与基底。: This is not a complete atomic Slater-integral model; material parameters also depend on screening and the basis.
跃迁强度与偏振方向投影后的偶极矩阵元模平方相关。: Transition intensity is related to the squared modulus of the dipole matrix element projected along the polarization direction.
强度常以相对值显示，需区分振幅、模平方与简并态平均。: Intensities are often relative; distinguish amplitudes, squared moduli, and averages over degenerate states.
电偶极近似不自动包括磁偶极、声子辅助或实际线宽。: The electric-dipole approximation does not automatically include magnetic-dipole or phonon-assisted processes, or actual linewidths.
质量加权力常数的 Fourier 变换矩阵，本征值给角频率平方。: The Fourier-transformed, mass-weighted force-constant matrix; its eigenvalues give squared angular frequencies.
声子本征矢的归一和质量因子决定实际原子位移及散射振幅。: Phonon eigenvector normalization and mass factors determine physical atomic displacements and scattering amplitudes.
简并模可任意换基，比较物理量时应使用完整简并子空间。: Degenerate modes admit changes of basis; use the entire degenerate subspace when comparing physical observables.
谐振子频率与Bose占据决定振动自由能、熵和定容热容。: Harmonic-oscillator frequencies and Bose occupations determine vibrational free energy, entropy, and constant-volume heat capacity.
虚频不能直接代入稳定谐振子的热力学公式。: Imaginary frequencies cannot be directly inserted into stable harmonic-oscillator thermodynamic formulas.
通过多个体积的静态能和体积依赖声子自由能求平衡体积随温度的变化。: Determine temperature-dependent equilibrium volume using static energies at several volumes and volume-dependent phonon free energies.
在每个体积仍使用谐振子，温度效应由频率对体积的依赖引入。: Each volume still uses harmonic oscillators; temperature effects enter through the volume dependence of frequencies.
极性/轴性与时间反演奇偶性决定额外符号；相同秩并不代表相同变换律。: Polar/axial character and time-reversal parity determine extra signs; equal tensor rank does not imply equal transformation laws.
二阶极化率把两个入射场分量耦合为二倍频极化。: The second-order optical susceptibility couples two incident-field components into a polarization at twice the frequency.
电偶极体SHG在反演对称晶体中受禁，表面/磁偶极等机制不包含在此简单判据中。: Bulk electric-dipole SHG is forbidden in inversion-symmetric crystals. Surface, magnetic-dipole, and other mechanisms are outside this simple criterion.
原胞散射体的复振幅相加，强度由模平方决定，位点相位可导致消光。: Add complex amplitudes from the primitive-cell scatterers, then take the squared modulus for intensity. Site phases can cause extinction.
必须区分晶格系统消光、基底干涉零点和结构因子太小；波长影响可达反射。: Distinguish lattice systematic absences, basis-interference zeros, and merely small structure factors. The wavelength affects which reflections are accessible.
教学棒谱不等于包含多重散射、仪器分辨与真实原子形状因子的完整实验图谱。: A teaching stick spectrum is not a complete experimental pattern with multiple scattering, instrumental resolution, and actual atomic form factors.
将超胞本征态投影到原胞平移特征扇区，恢复原胞动量分辨的谱权重。: Project supercell eigenstates onto primitive-translation eigensectors to recover primitive-cell momentum-resolved spectral weights.
展开权重依赖原胞/超胞映射与轨道对应；谱权重不是新的一条本征能带。: Unfolding weights depend on the primitive/supercell mapping and orbital correspondence; a spectral weight is not an additional eigenband.
对无序、缺陷或磁超胞需保持同一轨道规范并核对权重求和规则。: For disorder, defects, or magnetic supercells, retain a consistent orbital gauge and verify weight sum rules.
从实空间种子、位点稳定子和完整位点轨道构造周期轨道基，再得到各k纤维的群作用。: Construct a periodic orbital basis from a real-space seed, its site stabilizer, and the complete orbit of sites; this determines the group action in each k fiber.
原胞内位点轨道多重性: Site-orbit multiplicity within the primitive cell
位点稳定子由真正固定种子的操作组成，轨道—稳定子关系控制诱导维数。: The site stabilizer contains operations that genuinely fix the seed; the orbit–stabilizer relation controls the induced dimension.
原胞内轨道位点数: Number of orbit sites within the primitive cell
若Rr₀+t=r₀+L，应使用平移t−L的操作真正固定r₀。: If Rr₀+t=r₀+L, use the operation with translation part t−L to fix r₀ exactly.
无自旋2₁螺旋作用两次得到整格平移，沿轴本征值随k积累相位。: Applying a spinless 2₁ screw twice gives a full lattice translation; its axial eigenvalues acquire a k-dependent phase.
需操作确实保留所选k；自旋双值会多一个旋量符号。: The operation must actually preserve the selected k; double-valued spin representations contribute an extra spinor sign.
核声子散射与磁自旋散射的算符、质量因子和偏振投影不同。: Nuclear phonon scattering and magnetic spin scattering use different operators, mass factors, and polarization projections.
Q=0时方向未定义，须使用所声明的极限或禁用该点。: At Q=0 the direction is undefined; use the declared limit or disable that point.
未包括真实材料磁形式因子和所有仪器因素时应称相对模型强度。: Without actual magnetic form factors and all instrumental factors, call the output a relative model intensity.
热平衡下能量损失和能量获得侧的散射权重由占据与详细平衡联系。: In thermal equilibrium, occupations and detailed balance relate scattering weights on the energy-loss and energy-gain sides.
正负能量转移的定义必须先固定；产生激发与湮灭激发的权重分别含n_B+1与n_B。: First fix positive/negative energy-transfer conventions. Creating an excitation has weight n_B+1; annihilating one has weight n_B.
实际带电畴壁、弹性约束和多分量转动需额外电场与耦合项。: Actual charged domain walls, elastic constraints, and multicomponent rotations require additional electric-field and coupling terms.
对序参量空间不均匀性付出的能量代价，与局域势共同决定壁厚度。: The energy cost of spatially nonuniform order parameters; together with the local potential it determines the wall thickness.
在给定粒子数和有限格点的Fock空间里保留跃迁及局域相互作用。: Retain hopping and local interactions in the Fock space of a specified particle number on a finite set of lattice sites.
无量纲，范围依格点数: Dimensionless; its range depends on the number of lattice sites
本站操作名字保留上游BC标签；下标可能同时包含旋转阶数和轴编号，不能按空间群螺旋: Operation names retain upstream BC labels. A subscript may combine a rotation order and an axis index; do not interpret it as a space-group screw subscript.
二重旋转操作标签；实际作用以rotation矩阵为准: Twofold-rotation operation label; the rotation matrix defines the actual action
例如C31+的31是操作下标整体，不应自动改成3₁螺旋；磁群撇号与BC轴撇号须由: For example, 31 in C31+ is one complete operation subscript, not automatically a 3₁ screw. Distinguish magnetic-group primes from BC axis primes using context.
主三重轴与竖直镜面的点群: A point group with a principal threefold axis and vertical mirrors
C3v中的3v属于整体下标；HM晶格符号C2和Schönflies的C₂不是同一: The 3v in C3v is one complete subscript. HM lattice notation C2 and Schönflies C₂ use different syntax.
把电子添加或移除的谱分解成多体初态到相邻粒子数末态的跃迁。能级差决定峰位置，真实: Decompose electron-addition/removal spectra into transitions from many-body initial states to final states with neighboring particle numbers. Energy differences fix peak positions; actual matrix elements determine visibility.
指定轨道、自旋的添加或移除谱密度: Addition/removal spectral density for a specified orbital and spin
完整添加谱的积分权重: Integrated weight of the complete addition spectrum
完整移除谱的积分权重: Integrated weight of the complete removal spectrum
对轨道、自旋求和或改变跃迁算符会改变归一化；不能把本局域和规则机械套到任意响应。: Summing over orbitals or spins, or changing transition operators, changes normalization. This local sum rule cannot be applied mechanically to arbitrary responses.
比较线宽前核对半高半宽、全高半宽和能量/频率单位；有限积分窗口不会包含全部Lor: Check half-width at half-maximum, full width at half-maximum, and energy/frequency units before comparing linewidths. Finite windows omit some Lorentzian tails.
多体谱模型中的在位排斥 U: Onsite repulsion U in the many-body spectral model
Hubbard 谱实验中两个反自旋电子在同一站点双占据所需的相互作用能；它改变相: The interaction energy for opposite-spin electrons doubly occupying one site in the Hubbard spectral experiment; it changes neighboring particle-number sectors and transition weights.
在本站二站点Holstein模型中，局域电子占据与无量纲振子位移耦合，调制位点能: In this site's two-site Holstein model, local electron occupation couples to dimensionless oscillator displacement, modulating site energies rather than directly changing hopping.
电子条件下的振动云: Vibrational cloud conditioned on electron location
条件位移不是自发对称破缺的直接证据；二站点模型不确定真实材料极化子半径或自俘获临: Conditional displacement alone is not evidence of spontaneous symmetry breaking. This two-site model does not determine actual polaron radii or self-trapping critical points.
本模型维数为2(N_max+1)²。相邻截断检查同时看能量、局域量与最高层权重；: The model dimension is 2(N_max+1)². Adjacent-cutoff checks examine energies, local observables, and highest-level probabilities. Eigenstate residuals test the finite matrix, not convergence with the cutoff.
Tr_Bρ，子系统A的约化密度矩阵: Tr_Bρ, the reduced density matrix of subsystem A
对B基底指标求迹: Trace over the basis index of B
σ_z通道产生的纯退相干率: Pure-dephasing rate produced by the σ_z channel
驱动与交换下完整曲线不必为单指数；固定局域通道不自动满足含相互作用Hamilto: Driven or exchange-coupled curves need not be single exponentials. Fixed local channels do not automatically satisfy thermal detailed balance for an interacting Hamiltonian.
共振、无耗散且从↑出发时 P_↑(t)=cos²(Ωt/2)。不要把rad/ns: On resonance, without dissipation and starting from ↑, P_↑(t)=cos²(Ωt/2). Do not treat rad/ns as cycles/ns.
此为常量有效驱动模型，未包含完整实验脉冲、旋转波近似误差或真实仪器噪声。: A constant effective-drive model, without full experimental pulses, rotating-wave-approximation errors, or actual instrumental noise.
正J对应反铁磁交换；H/ℏ中单重态与三重态本征值分别为−3J/4、J/4。该输入: Positive J gives antiferromagnetic exchange. The singlet/triplet eigenvalues of H/ℏ are −3J/4 and J/4. This input is not an energy in eV as in the Hubbard interface; conversion requires ℏ.
两条能带的共同位移: Common energy shift of both bands
投影系数不是材料拟合；关闭生成元后不再声称保留原群，局部开隙也不直接给出完整布里: Projected coefficients are not material fits. Disabling a generator no longer preserves the original group, and a local gap alone does not give a full-Brillouin-zone topological number.
动量作为极向量按R变换，真实自旋作为轴向量按det(R)R变换；两者在镜面下不同: Momentum is a polar vector transforming by R; physical spin is axial and transforms by det(R)R. Their mirror actions differ.
保持指定序参量的操作构成稳定子群；母群轨道包含所有对称相关状态。: Operations preserving the specified order parameter form its stabilizer subgroup; the parent-group orbit contains every symmetry-related state.
本实验为带符号置换表示，输出最小整数轨道和；不自动决定自由能系数。: This experiment uses signed-permutation representations and outputs orbit sums normalized to minimal integer coefficients. It does not determine free-energy coefficients automatically.
有向键i→j的交换张量: Exchange tensor for the directed bond i→j
不能以一般体物性张量代替键约束；对称性只限定形式，不给出参数大小。: A general bulk-property tensor cannot replace bond constraints. Symmetry fixes allowed forms, not parameter magnitudes.
交换张量反对称部分对应的轴向向量，决定D·(S_i×S_j)项。: The axial vector associated with the exchange tensor's antisymmetric part, defining the D·(S_i×S_j) term.
依赖有向键次序的DMI向量: DMI vector dependent on directed-bond order
键中心反演约束D为零；缺少反演仅移除这一禁止条件，不保证D非零。: Bond-center inversion forces D=0. Absence of inversion only removes this prohibition; it does not guarantee nonzero D.
从交换张量的对称部分减去迹的三分之一，得到对称无迹各向异性。: Subtract one third of the trace times the identity from the symmetric exchange tensor to obtain symmetric traceless anisotropy.
这里Γ是交换矩阵，不是布里渊区中心或电极展宽。: Here Γ is an exchange matrix, not the Brillouin-zone center or lead broadening.
S→det(R)RS；反演下真实自旋不变。键操作还可能交换站点。: S→det(R)RS; physical spin is inversion even. Bond operations may additionally exchange sites.
无显含时间的观测量: An observable with no explicit time dependence
d⟨Q⟩/dt=i⟨[H/ℏ,Q]⟩，未设ℏ=1混用能量与角频率。: d⟨Q⟩/dt=i⟨[H/ℏ,Q]⟩. Keep ℏ explicit rather than mixing energy and angular-frequency units by silently setting ℏ=1.
完整开放系统的守恒条件由生成元对观测量的伴随作用决定。: Conservation in the complete open system is determined by the generator's adjoint action on observables.
还需时间反演保持Hamiltonian；这里无晶格动量，不等同于全布里渊区磁空间: Time reversal must also preserve the Hamiltonian. There is no lattice momentum here, so this is not a full-Brillouin-zone magnetic-space-group diagnostic.
同型分量的字符投影: Character projection onto an isotypic component
用不可约特征标加权群平均，从给定表示空间中取出该不可约表示的全部副本。: Weight a group average by an irreducible character to extract every copy of that irreducible representation from the given space.
P_α=(d_α/|G|)Σ_g χ_α(g)^*D(g)。迹等于该同型分量的总: P_α=(d_α/|G|)Σ_g χ_α(g)^*D(g). Its trace equals the total dimension of that isotypic component.
本实验采用 C₄ᵥ 的四轨道或两副本表示；投影到重复表示时不自动挑出某一个副本。: This experiment uses a four-orbital C₄ᵥ representation or two copies of it. Projection onto a repeated irreducible type does not automatically select an individual copy.
目标不可约表示的矩阵元: Matrix element of the target irreducible representation
判断算符表示与初态的直积是否包含末态表示；包含重数大于零只表示对称性允许。: Check whether the operator representation tensor the initial representation contains the final representation. Positive containment multiplicity means only that symmetry permits the transition.
偏振、具体波函数和约化矩阵元仍可令允许跃迁为零；不把有限群包含重数当作 SU(2: Polarization, actual wavefunctions, and reduced matrix elements can still make an allowed transition vanish. Finite-group containment multiplicities are not general SU(2) CG coefficients.
重复不可约表示的 Schur 结构: Schur structure of repeated irreducible representations
重复 E 的四维同型空间通常可分成两个不同能量的双重态；不能把四维同型空间直接称: Two copies of E form a four-dimensional isotypic space, usually split into two doublets at different energies. The whole isotypic space is not automatically a protected fourfold degeneracy.
波矢星收集母点群作用下模倒格矢等价后的全部不同臂；实场要求 q 与 −q 的系数: A wavevector star contains distinct arms generated by the parent point group modulo reciprocal-lattice vectors. A real field requires q and −q coefficients to be complex conjugates.
母倒格分数波矢: Fractional wavevector in the parent reciprocal basis
用实场均方与全部 Fourier 权重之和的相等检查归一化，并区分复系数相位和强: Check normalization by equating the real-field mean square to the sum of all Fourier weights, distinguishing coefficient phases from intensities.
周期 Bloch 基底中的操作矩阵: Operation matrix in the periodic Bloch basis
满足 2k 为倒格整数的动量: Momentum for which 2k is a reciprocal-lattice vector
伙伴交换诊断同时要求整条线属于 G 小群、两端为 TRIM、G 与 T 均为对称: Partner switching requires G to preserve every momentum on the line, both ends to be TRIM, and both G and T to be symmetries. Overlapping bands alone do not prove protection.
破滑移或螺旋的反对易质量项: Anticommuting mass term that breaks a glide or screw
在当前明确的两带或四带模型中加入反对易质量，可检验破坏哪项约束能够打开中间直接隙: Add an anticommuting mass to the explicitly defined two- or four-band model to test which broken constraint can open the middle direct gap.
全动量线最小中间直接隙: Minimum middle direct gap over the full momentum line
该结论来自所声明的矩阵及反对易关系，不是任意螺旋材料的能隙公式；直接隙不等于间接: This follows from the declared matrices and anticommutation relations, not a universal gap formula for screw-symmetric materials. A direct gap is neither an indirect gap nor a three-dimensional insulation criterion.
交换同时作用于粒子的全部自由度；电子的轨道与自旋交换符号相乘。: Particle exchange acts on every degree of freedom; for electrons, multiply the orbital and spin exchange signs.
要求对所有力非负时，S 必须半正定；单次激励的正结果不足以证明。: Nonnegative entropy production for every force vector requires positive-semidefinite S. One positive result for one drive does not establish this.
法向有限、两个面内方向周期；不把真空超胞的法向平移当作孤立薄膜操作。: Finite in the normal direction, periodic in both in-plane directions. Normal translations of a vacuum supercell are not operations of an isolated film.
空间不正操作作用于自旋时多出行列式符号；时间反演另行反转波矢与自旋。: Improper spatial operations contribute an extra determinant sign for spin. Time reversal separately reverses both wavevector and spin.
采用主动操作。复波函数的反幺正变换还必须包含共轭。: Active operations are used. An antiunitary transformation of a complex wavefunction must additionally include complex conjugation.
镜像使用不正操作；与镜像比较重合时只允许正旋转、平移及同种原子的对应。: Mirroring uses an improper operation. Registration against the mirror image permits only proper rotations, translations, and matching atoms of the same species.
